steps.description: Elastic-net penalized logistic regression (glmnet) on log-CPM expression of the filtered genes. Nested cross-validation: outer CV (e.g. 10-fold, stratified, fixed seed) estimates performance; inner CV selects the lambda (report the lambda rule, min or 1-SE) and the alpha (elastic-net mixing). The gene filter, the normalization scaling, and any feature selection happen strictly inside each training fold via a pipeline - the outer error estimate must not touch genes selected from all samples; the outer estimate is optimistic otherwise, and this must be stated. Report outer-fold pooled ROC curve with AUC and bootstrap/DeLong CI, sensitivity/specificity at the ROC-chosen threshold, and the genes with nonzero coefficients and how stable they are across outer folds. Compare against a trivial baseline (majority class). Also report the expected accuracy for one future sample with the CI, not a single point estimate.
acceptance_criteria: nested CV structure: outer folds never contribute to feature selection or lambda choice
filtering and scaling fit inside training folds only (preprocessing_scope = filter_and_scaling_inside_each_training_fold)

random seed recorded

plan.title: Case vs control blood RNA-seq DE + classifier
plan.analytical_narrative: 120 samples (60 case / 60 control) of human whole-blood gene-level counts (12000 genes x 121 columns incl. gene-symbol column, Salmon counts) with a 120x2 metadata table. The question is two-fold: (1) what differs between cases and controls, and (2) can a gene-expression classifier distinguish a new case from a control, and how accurate would it be? Because each group holds 60 samples (a population cohort), the knowledge rules mandate limma-voom with a fixed-effects linear model over the negative-binomial count models, which over-call false positives at this sample size; a Wilcoxon rank-sum check is run as a control. The classifier is penalized logistic regression with nested cross-validation, with gene filtering and scaling strictly inside each training fold so the error estimate is honest. No batch covariate is needed (single batch). Data is small (~10-15 MB CSV), so resources are modest.

steps.method: vst blind PCA and sample distance heatmap
penalized logistic regression (glmnet) with nested cross-validation, feature selection and scaling inside training folds
report with diagnostics and reproducibility record

parameters.value: method, versions, design, thresholds, n_tested, n_de, session_info
